title: Truchas 2D flow solver
description: Controls for the 2D flow solver. The projection-solver sublist is always required. The momentum-solver sublist is required for viscous flow and is omitted for inviscid flow; that dependency is determined by the separate flow-model object.

courant-number.description: Courant number used to limit the flow time step. It must be greater than zero and no greater than one; the default is 0.5.

volume-tracking.description: Optional controls for material volume-fraction transport.

momentum-solver.description: HYPRE hybrid controls for the implicit momentum solve. Required for viscous flow and unused for inviscid flow.

projection-solver.description: HYPRE hybrid controls for the pressure-projection solve. This sublist is required.
